subject: Approval marshal & boarding timeline
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Harrison <alex.harrison@bluecrest.com>, Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval marshal & boarding timeline

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive eval week. Per our MAP, we scoped the final approvals and paper steps so Bluecrest can go live with Redwood Dedicated in early February. To keep momentum I want to lock the final approval marshal and the signature/windows schedule:

- What we need from Bluecrest: Legal sign-off on the SOW (attached SOW_Bluecrest_v2.docx), procurement PO or purchase order number, and primary production signer.
- What Redwood will deliver on signature: DocuSign envelope (we'll send), provisioning of reserved capacity, and a short pre-onboarding smoke test window before the start date.

Proposed timeline (high level):
1) 2027-01-24 EOD: final redline acceptance / confirmation from Bluecrest legal
2) 2027-01-25: DocuSign sent and routed to signers (two windows: AM 09:00-11:30 PT or PM 15:00-17:30 PT — we can route to match your procurement)
3) 2027-02-07: Redwood dedicates capacity and starts internal pre-onboarding tests
4) 2027-02-08: Bluecrest + Redwood smoke tests and kickoff ramp (target production cutover window 2027-02-10)

Attachments: MAP_v4.pdf (mutual action plan summary), SOW_Bluecrest_v2.docx, start-date-matrix.xlsx. I've also attached a small SOC2 evidence bundle we referenced (SOC2-evidence-stub.zip).

Ask: can you confirm primary signer and whether the AM or PM signature window works for you? If you need us to draft a limited SLA amendment for the dedicated pool, let me know and we can attach it to the DocuSign envelope.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

From: Alex Harrison <alex.harrison@bluecrest.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@bluecrest.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval marshal & boarding timeline

Thanks, Sean — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers from our side: 

- Primary signer: Sara D'Souza (General Counsel) will be the legal signer. I'll loop her in once we have the final SOW version.
- Procurement: Priya is confirming the PO number; expected by 01/24 EOD.
- Signature window: PM window (15:00-17:30 PT) works better for our ops team.

Two asks from Bluecrest Legal / Procurement: 
1) We may need a one-paragraph SLA addendum around data retention for the pilot stores (small change) — can Redwood produce a redline?
2) Can you confirm that the reserved capacity ramp includes a one-week rollback/fallback plan if latency regressions appear during the first 72 hours of production? We need that in writing to sign off.

If you can send an updated SOW with the SLA addendum and include the fallback language, Sara will triage and we should be able to sign by 01/25 afternoon.

—Alex
Alex Harrison
Head of Retail Integrations, Bluecrest Retail
alex.harrison@bluecrest.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Harrison <alex.harrison@bluecrest.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval marshal & boarding timeline

Alex — thanks. I can take point on the SLA addendum and fallback clause. Quick notes so legal/procurement know what to expect: 

- SLA addendum: one paragraph + committal on retention window for pilot-only logs (30 days) and production logs (90 days) — I'll attach a redline to the SOW and send before EOD 01/23.
- Fallback plan: we'll include explicit rollback steps — automatic routing to a smaller-capacity variant and pre-signed canary fallback policy for the first 72 hours. We'll include a signed attestation in the DocuSign envelope that Redwood will revert traffic to the previous model variant if latency > SLA for a sustained 15-minute window during initial ramp.

Signature logistics: if Bluecrest confirms PM window, we'll schedule the DocuSign envelope for 01/25 at 15:00 PT. I'll also include a brief 'start date matrix' that shows tentative dates for provisioning and the two kickoff slot options. See start-date-matrix.xlsx (attached).

Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval marshal & boarding timeline
To: Alex Harrison <alex.harrison@bluecrest.com>, Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Marcus — can you confirm engineering can commit to the smoke-test windows 02/08-02/09 and that we can provision the dedicated pool on 02/07? Below is the short checklist we need completed before the kickoff: 

- Reserved GPU pool provisioned and reachable from Bluecrest VPC (VPN test)
- Canary model variant deployed with KV cache warmup script
- Load harness smoke test (50 concurrent sessions) and latency/99th-percentile runbook attached
- Monitoring hooks and tracing tokens shared with Bluecrest SREs

If any of these are at risk, flag now so Kimberly can adjust the start-date matrix.

Thanks — Sean

Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Reply:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Approval marshal & boarding timeline — need engineering pre-onboard checklist

Sean / Kim — engineering confirmed provisioning on 02/07 and the smoke-test window 02/08-02/09. I'll assign two engineers for the test window (Anita + Hugo). Action items for us:
- Provision reserved pool by 02/07 09:00 PT
- Run KV cache warmup script and validate top-prefix cache hit > 60%
- Execute load harness 50-session run and verify p99 < 450ms
- Share monitoring/tracing dashboard with Bluecrest SREs by 02/06 EOD

I'll post the test roster and harness artifact links in the shared workspace. If procurement signs on 01/25 PM we should be good to hit 02/10 production cutover.

Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Sean
